On Sat, 12 Jan 2002 22:19:38 -0600, "Diablo" <nospam@nospam.org>
wrote:

>Thank you!  It refreshing to see that I am not the only Unabomber
>admirer out there.  All of you, please read the manifesto carefully.
>It is the truth.  Try to find any arguments to discredit it and you
>will fail.

Hmm... I've just skimmed through it and I've only read some parts in
their entirety.  He has a *lot* of very insighful and valid points in
there.   I'm not sure if industrial society is really hopeless
though... there may just be a need for some drastic changes, not
throwing it all away.

>"In order to get our message before the public with some chance
>of making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."
>-- Paragraph 96

Yeah, it's really hard to get a message accross... he's right.   I'm
sure if he didn't kill some people a lot less people would have seen
that manifesto and thought about it.  However, I think that because he
killed people a lot of people just think that the unabomber was some
crazy person who killed some people... that's the main and only
impression he managed to communicate in most cases.

--
Boris
